evidence.title: Add as MCP · Annual Report Archive

name: Annual Report Archive
summary: Searchable archive of 3,002 vintage corporate annual report covers from 1945–2023, also served as a remote MCP server.
description: A browsable gallery of 3,002 historic corporate annual-report covers scanned from archive.org, university libraries and design archives. Filter by decade, industry or color, search by design vibe, company, year or what's pictured, and connect the archive to Cursor or Claude through a free remote MCP server.
contains: search by design vibe, company, year or what's on the cover
remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth) with tools searchcovers, getcover, similarcovers, listfacets
sources: Internet Archive, McGill, bitsavers, UW Libraries, Portal to Texas History, Paul Rand and SVA archives
